title: Volume Review and Tier Moves — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Account Management Bulletin
content:
The tier of a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service follows the employer's sustained volume, not its request.

**Rule.** A volume review moves only a service whose status is active. When the payout counts of the tier's required number of consecutive complete months all fall in another tier's monthly disbursement band, the service moves to the tier whose band contains the latest month's count on the first day of the following month, up or down; a single unusual month moves nothing. Fees already debited are never re-rated.

The months reviewed are the service's most recent complete calendar months, each counted as its number of payouts. The service's status is read from Paystride's service record before a move.

## Illustrations (hypothetical counts, three consecutive months required)

| Service on | Latest three complete months, latest first | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Core | 1240, 1105, 1960 | all three in the Growth band: moves to Growth on the first day of the following month |
| Core | 1300, 980, 1500 | one month in the Core band: no move |
| Growth | 610, 720, 880 | all three in the Core band: moves down to Core on the first day of the following month |
| Growth | 1200, 1100, 6400 | only one month outside the Growth band: no move |

A service that is suspended or in pending setup is not moved by a review, whatever its counts. Fees debited before a move are never re-rated.
